newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's YPF gets Syntroleum Process license.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's YPF gets Syntroleum Process license.

text.p: Argentine oil company YPF SA said Monday U.S. Syntroleum Corp granted it a non-exclusive license for its Syntroleum Process used to convert natural gas into synthethic crude and transport fuels.

The agreement grants YPF rights to use the process to make transportation fuels outside North America and its application in Latin America and South East Asia is under consideration, YPF said in a press release.
The process has been designed for plants that produce a minimum of 2,000 to 50,000 barrels per day.
